'''BTZ-47 heavy assault cannon''' was a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] model used during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. One such cannon named [[Bitsy]] was used by the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] recruiter [[K'krohl]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
BTZ-47 heavy assault cannon appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the weapon used by K'krohl.
